checkedAndRetained: Xue Pan’s escape from embarrassment, untrained merchant ambition, mother’s misgivings and Baochai’s practical advice remain distinct voices. Seasonal dates, two/three thousand, eight hundred/one thousand taels and reading quantities preserved.
Six travelers, three luggage carts, four hired mules, own iron-blue mule and spare horse retained. Older son, wet-nurse’s husband and working-age experienced servants distinguished.
Xiangling’s 奶奶 means Xue Yima, 大爷 means Xue Pan; Ping’er’s 老爷/二爷 mean Jia She/Jia Lian. Two additional garden residents retained without inventing a companion’s identity.

Fan ownership, twenty fans, thousand-tael refusal, five-hundred-tael offer, fabricated official debt, confiscation and uncertain survival retained. Jia Lian’s objection, beating while standing, two facial wounds and external medicinal use preserved.

Poetics dialogue retains the current crossed 虚/实 pairing without correcting the character’s theory; tonal positions one/three/five and two/four/six are not recast as rhymes or Japanese syllable counts. Intention takes precedence over diction after Xiangling’s initial misunderstanding.

Wang Wei’s aliases, Li Bai’s alias, Lu You’s alias and abbreviated Xie/Ruan/Yu/Bao kept without invented readings. Sequence of five-character regulated verse, seven-character regulated verse and seven-character quatrains, with respective hundred/hundred-to-two-hundred counts, preserved.

Quoted poetry and discussion preserve 直/円, 白/青, 余/上 and 依依; olive-weight metaphor and remembered boat journey remain Xiangling’s observations. Tao Yuanming’s dim distant village is not made a warm or dawn landscape.

Both eight-line novice poems, blocks 29–36 and 40–47, independently compared line by line for images and first/last boundaries. Jade mirror, ice disk, silver candle, painted balustrade, plum, willow, powder, frost and lingering appearance retained; no invented rhymes or third poem added. Awkwardness and characters’ critiques are not polished into accomplished poetry.

Baoyu’s parrot oath, unauthorized circulation of women’s poems, Baochai’s teasing, fourteen-Han/fifteen-Shan rhyme joke with 閑, three-tenths-finished painting and dream composition remain in sequence. Narrator does not adopt characters’ judgments as fact.
